image.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: professional hairstyle-analysis teaching image for a mobile app
Primary request: Create one horizontal four-panel contact sheet showing the SAME fictional adult East Asian woman in her CURRENT grown-out short haircut from four true views: front, exact left profile, exact right profile, and back. This is a pre-service analysis image, not a makeover and not a proposed haircut.
Scene/backdrop: plain warm light-gray salon wall, identical neutral camera distance, lens and soft daylight in all panels.
Subject: adult woman around 33 with natural skin texture and calm neutral expression. Her visible facial outline is elongated oval with a moderately high forehead; the current head-and-hair silhouette reads slightly tall and narrow from the front. From both profiles the upper crown looks a little high while the occipital transition looks relatively flat. Neck is medium length; shoulders are medium-to-broad and gently squared. She wears the exact same simple muted taupe-gray crew-neck top in every panel.
Current hair: dark natural brown, grown-out short pixie-bob. Near-center-to-slight-side natural part. Crown length has grown and lies in a narrow elevated arc, not a salon-teased high crown. Temple and ear areas are relatively close/tucked, with a few long face-framing pieces reaching the upper cheek to jaw. The occipital area lacks a strong rounded projection; lower back and nape have grown soft uneven wisps. Hair is clean, dry, lightly air-dried, medium-textured straight hair with realistic flyaways; no obvious curls, perm, shine spray, or blowout.
Style/medium: highly realistic editorial salon documentation photograph, honest hair and skin texture, no beauty filter or facial reshaping.
Composition/framing: four equal vertical panels in one landscape image. Every panel must show the complete top of head, full hair outline and neckline, neck and both shoulders. True orthographic-feeling views; profiles are genuine 90-degree side views, and back shows no face. Keep facial identity, anatomy, hair length, parting, clothing and lighting consistent across all panels.
Lighting/mood: soft diffused neutral daylight, analytical and clear, no dramatic highlights.
Constraints: no text, labels, arrows, measurements, watermark, accessories, earrings, glasses, hands, salon tools or extra people. Do not change hairstyle between panels. Show only the current grown-out state. Do not exaggerate anatomy or make medical claims.
Avoid: makeover comparison, after image, reference hairstyle, glamorous styling, obvious perm curls, teased roots, wet hair, excessive symmetry, synthetic wig texture, cropped crown, cropped shoulders, missing nape, three-quarter profiles, different person or clothing.
